verdict.rationale: LibreOffice publishes a first-party filter reference (convertfilters.html). It lists formats with their filter names, MIME types and extensions, from DOCX, XLSM and PPTX to EPUB, SVG and Parquet. The command-line docs show how a filter name is used with --convert-to and --infilter. However, the evidence never shows an explicit input→output matrix or whether each filter is import-only or export-capable, so checking a specific pair before trying it is only partly supported. Missing for 10: an explicit input-to-output pair mapping, import/export direction per filter, independent corroboration that the listing is reliable for checking pairs.

support.subject: As a power user, the tool documents which input formats convert to which outputs, so I can check a pair before trying it

citations.quote: --infilter=InputFilterName [:InputFilterParam[,param]] Forces an input filter type, if possible.
